overall_recommendation: Do not batch merge these five. PR 183 is source-review SAFE; hold 174/184 for unresolved existing gates and 179/181 for P2 source contracts. Revalidate resolved integration before packaging/release.

findings.trigger: Hosted production inspector switches among three live chats and restores detached scroll.
findings.detail: Exact-head hosted job 119862856805 fails assertion with (1000, 1410). No callout source defect established; unchanged fixture contains no callout markers. Local baseline/candidate passes do not resolve hosted failure.
findings.remediation: Run unchanged Linux hosted inspector on matched baseline and candidate; establish cause and restore the gate without weakening the assertion.

findings.trigger: Dependency-changing PR runs npm audit --audit-level=high in pinned-and-lockfile.
findings.detail: Job 119896267138 fails on Vite 7.3.6 advisories. Vite is 7.3.6 in base and head, and no existing lockfile package version changed. This is inherited debt exposed by the gate, not a new Mermaid vulnerability.
findings.remediation: Integrate a separately reviewed exact-pin Vite/security remediation, regenerate lockfile and rerun existing dependency, build and browser gates. Keep the audit threshold.

findings.trigger: Switch away during provider-free stream and return to virtualized long Alpha history.
findings.detail: Fresh actual-head browser run times out waiting for two mounted SVGs. Nine earlier groups pass; errors=[]; screenshot shows History 0/1 and Jump to latest. Potential viewport/fixture precondition, not attributed source regression.
findings.remediation: Verify the user-visible Jump to latest and both completed persisted diagrams after return; separately validate intended scroll ownership. Keep safety assertions.

findings.trigger: Installed skill frontmatter name differs from its folder/path, or multiple records share a display name.
findings.detail: New picker persists skill.name; scheduler calls skill_view(name), which searches paths/folder names. Real temporary Friendly Skill in folder-slug is listed but skipped in _build_job_prompt. New test mocks skill_view and therefore hides the defect.
findings.remediation: Use a scheduler-resolvable stable skill identity/path with compatible handling for old string jobs; resolve explicitly and reject ambiguity. Add real filesystem catalog -> save/reload -> prompt test without mocking skill_view.

findings.trigger: User opens new Outputs control on Windows, which lacks POSIX O_NOFOLLOW/dir_fd support.
findings.detail: Every request returns 503 by construction while CronPage.tsx:601 offers Outputs unconditionally. Simulated capability absence reproduces exact 503. Safe fail-closed behavior, but broken advertised Windows feature.
findings.remediation: Implement secure Windows access with reparse-point/race containment and tests, or expose server capability and disable/hide Outputs with a clear unsupported reason. Do not replace it with a racy resolve-then-open check.

installed_package_evidence: No installed macOS or Windows verification performed. This is a release evidence gap distinct from the concrete Windows source defect in PR 181.
